messages:
Samir Patel: Hey team — quick sync on PR #4824 (migration guide + sdk snippets). I want to land before EOD. Preview link: https://deploy-preview.redwood/docs/4824 :eyes:
Jess Liu: I can review but CI preview is failing on the code block linting.
Ava Romero: I saw that — `prettier` error on the python snippet indentation.
Connor O'Neill: Pinging docs-bot to re-run preview after I push a tiny fix.
docs-bot: Build queued for branch docs/migration-guide-4824. ETA ~3m.
Jess Liu: Small stylistic thing: our style guide prefers active voice and 'the Redwood platform' instead of 'we' in migration guides. Can we change 2-3 sentences? 
Samir Patel: Good catch. I'll reword. Example: replace "we recommend" -> "Redwood recommends".
Ava Romero: Also, API naming: use `client = RedwoodClient()` not `client = Client()`. Keeps examples consistent across SDKs.
Connor O'Neill: For the SDK snippet migration, use the new v2 call shape: `client.generate(prompt="...")` instead of `client.text.generate(...)` — I'll add a one-line note about compatibility.
Jess Liu: After those edits, I'd be happy to approve. Can someone add a changelog entry under docs/migration? 
Samir Patel: Added changelog line at the top of the PR and pushed. Re-run preview now.
docs-bot: Preview build succeeded: https://deploy-preview.redwood/docs/4824 — visual diffs show code block fixed. :white_check_mark:
Jess Liu: LGTM. Leaving an approval now.
Ava Romero: Approved. :thumbsup:
Connor O'Neill: Merged and scheduled for next docs deploy. Nice quick turnaround.
